test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the production (in thousands) of two types (A and B) of cars by a company over the years 2016 to 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edebec04ad1dc9a4a19a94ef8181179dded12055b22ce2a980b1ff1ed9b63565.png] 

The ratio of the total production of type A cars to type B cars over the years is:
solution:
Total production of type A = 100 + 125 + 200 + 250 + 300 + 400 = 1375

Total production of type B = 150 + 200 + 150 + 200 + 250 + 300 = 1250

Ratio of total production of type A to type B = 1375 : 1250

Simplifying the ratio:

⇒ Ratio = 11 : 10

**∴ The ratio of the total production of type A cars to type B cars over the years is 11 : 10.**
